messages:
maria: Heads-up — during a routine audit I found a path where a rotated service account key allowed action as another svc via a merged scope. Seems related to the rewrap flow losing the per-route tag in KMS metadata.
kevin: wait — merged scope? can you paste the minimal trace?
maria: yea. short version: legacy ingest pipeline uses delegated service-account tokens. after we rewrapped the key yesterday, some reissued sub-tokens were missing the `route_id` tag. the authz layer falls back to unioning scopes across token lineage which accidentally allowed `route:payments` on a token that should only have `model:embed-only`.
kevin: oh no. so embeddings token could call per-route endpoints if flow unions scopes?
maria: exactly. only triggered when the parent token had a wildcard allowlist and child token lost metadata. only seen in the batch ingestors so far. small blast radius but sounds like privilege escalation.
sre-oncall: marked this as P1 for now. are there live requests hitting prod?
maria: yes — low volume. I put a temporary gate in the authz mesh to reject tokens missing `route_id` for per-route calls.
jun: can you share the example token payload (sanitized) and the KMS rewrap metadata snippet?
maria: posted sanitized snippet: ```json
{
  "sub": "svc-ingest@redwood",
  "scopes": ["model:open-embed-v1"],
  "parent_scope_source": "parent-token-123",
  "kms_rewrap_tags": null  // this is the problem, tag dropped during rewrap
}
```
alice: deploying a quick policy change: authz will now require explicit `route:` scope for any request to per-route endpoints unless token has `route_id` metadata. pushing to prod in 5.
kevin: good. longer-term fix?
maria: two parts: 1) fix rewrap to preserve KMS metadata tags (patch in kms-rewrap service), 2) change authz to treat lost-metadata as deny-by-default instead of unioning parent scopes. also add a detection to flag tokens that gained `route:` via unioning.
securitybot: INC-4578 created (severity: high) — security/incident triage channel: #incidents-security.
deploy-bot: deploy started: authz/deny-metadata-loss v1.2 -> prod.
sre-oncall: rollout observed 3xx->2xx auth errors for some batch jobs — alerting owners.
maria: noted. owners paged, will coordinate rollback if needed.
jun: for audit — current gap: cloud-audit logs show the call but the KMS tag that would identify the issuing route is missing. need a backfill plan to correlate by token lineage id.
ealice: (typo) alice: we should also rotate the legacy ingest service account secret and invalidate any derived sub-tokens, then re-issue via updated flow.
kevin: agree. can we automate an expunge of child tokens that originate from rewraps without tags? might be tricky.
maria: plan to: 1) emergency policy (done), 2) patch rewrap (in review), 3) rotate svc account creds (in progress), 4) add detection/backfill to audit logs (ticket created), 5) postmortem.
sre-oncall: capturing timeline — saving logs to secure bucket (s3://redwood-sec/inc-4578/).
jun: QA/steps for postmortem: reproduce in staging with rewrap simulation, assert metadata survives rewrap, and add unit/integration tests.
kevin: also add CI job that fuzzes token lineage and ensures authz never widens scopes on missing metadata.
alice: assigning owners: maria (sec lead), kevin (authz), jun (audit/backfill), sre-oncall (ops), i'm on rotation for creds.
securitybot: reminder — create a regression check that fails builds if rewrap drops tags: https://go/redwood/sec-tests
maria: thanks all. will update thread with timeline and links to tickets. :thumbsup:
